newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti PC owner Piedmont details equity capital.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti PC owner Piedmont details equity capital.

text.p: Piedmont International, the company which owns Olivetti PCs, said the initial equity capitalisation of the group had been increased to $65 million and was being paid into Piedmont International's account this week.
In a statement, it said it had agreed with Merrill Lynch to reduce the maximum amount of the loan facility previously announced to $75 million. It did not state the previous amount.
"All the conditions for the initial draw-down have now been met and the funds will be available to the Piedmont International group from Monday, July 7," it said.
Olivetti announced the sale of its personal computers operations to Piedmont in January.
